---
name: Add one detector
about: One supported tool or syntax with deterministic fixtures
labels: 'help wanted'
---

## Engineering problem

Name one tool, the real combined-branch failure and why current checks miss it.

## Proposed behavior and evidence source

Owner package, committed file format, bounded literal syntax, unknown cases,
check ID, evidence method and source locations. No repository execution.

## Reproducible acceptance scenario

Link the fixture/test file. Include positive, benign, base-existing,
single-branch, malformed and unsupported cases. Give the exact test command.

## Limitations and alternatives

What is unsupported? Could an existing adapter solve this? Apply `good first
issue` only after a maintainer has confirmed the scope is small and unclaimed.
